correctness.rationale: For the exact A4 action of twelve even signed coordinate permutations on C^3, decomposition under four sign characters splits the real Hermitian projector frame into a 3x3 diagonal block and three equal 2x2 off-diagonal blocks. Their eigenvalues are 4, (6D-2) twice, 2(1-D)±4|C_v| each threefold. The trace of the frame is 12; the eight traceless eigenvalues sum to 8, bounding the optimal least eigenvalue by 1 with equality iff D=1/2 and C_v=0. Reconstructed all 12 rotations and proved the explicit radical fiducial yields D=1/2,C_v=0; independently checked exactly all nine matrix units T(E)=E+tr(E)I and sum P_g=4I, and compared 100 newly sampled generic spectra to the formula within 1e-12. Exact group-block reasoning, not random tests, proves universal assertions. The 12 distinct projective orbit elements follow from the rank-nine spanning argument; Scott's 2-design identity then gives reconstruction.

value.rationale: A4 is a natural smallest nonabelian tetrahedral unitary symmetry for 3-level quantum tomography. Exact invertibility/conditioning for every fiducial, full optimality locus and a constructive 12-orbit 2-design solve a genuinely natural constrained design problem; the result is not merely the classical conditional 2-design reconstruction identity.

limitations: Unit fiducials and exactly twelve A4 rotations, equal rank-one projectors, Frobenius Hermitian linear tomography only; no universal 12-measurement phase retrieval minimality.
